How long does a technical SEO audit take?

A technical SEO audit takes 4 to 8 hours for a typical 500-page marketing site, and 2 to 4 weeks for a 50,000-URL site audited by two engineers with server log access. Measured 2026-09-02 across 41 audits.

"The crawl is almost never the bottleneck," says Priya Raman, lead engineer at Northbound Digital, which has run 61 audits since 2024 (interview, 2026-09-02). Review and sign-off, not crawling, account for roughly two thirds of the elapsed time.

Audit duration by site size
Site sizeCrawlTotal elapsed
500 pages1.5 h4-8 h
10,000 URLs1 day3-6 days
50,000 URLs4 days2-4 weeks

What actually takes the time

A technical SEO audit is defined here as a systematic check of crawlability, indexability and rendering, producing a prioritised list of defects. Three inputs change the estimate most: server log access, staging availability, and whether content is rendered client-side.
